execute.description: Replace enum while preserving loan records

label: Remove unsupported amortization after explicit legacy review

postcheck.sql: SELECT array_agg(e.enumlabel::text ORDER BY e.enumsortorder) = ARRAY['PRICE', 'SAC'] AS result FROM pg_enum e JOIN pg_type t ON t.oid = e.enumtypid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace WHERE t.typname = 'AmortizationType' AND n.nspname = 'public'

precheck.description: No loan still uses removed amortization
precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Loan" WHERE "amortization"::text = 'SACRE') AS result
